annotations.title: Get an owner organization and its care facilities

description: The tool gets an organization owner from Medicare's owner files by associate ID or by facility type and CCN. It returns the facilities it owns on record by setting, with role, share and start date. It returns the owner group it belongs to and the changes of ownership involving it. Each call returns 25 facilities with an offset. Individuals are counted, never named.

ccn.description: The facility's six-character CMS Certification Number (CCN).

offset.description: How many items to skip for the next page of a long list.

owner_id.description: The owner's ten-digit Medicare associate ID, as /owners pages show it.

type.description: The facility setting: nursing_home, home_health, hospice or hospital.

name: get_facility_owner
title: Get an owner organization and its care facilities
